ui.events.formula.after: C(Reaction day+n) / C(Reaction day) − 1: the n sessions after Reaction day
ui.events.formula.before: C(Reaction day−1) / C(Reaction day−1−n) − 1: the close before Reaction day against the close n sessions earlier
ui.events.formula.gap: O(Reaction day) / C(Reaction day−1) − 1: Reaction day's open against the previous close
ui.events.formula.reaction: C(Reaction day) / C(Reaction day−1) − 1: Reaction day's close against the previous close (gap included)
ui.events.kline_legend: Daily candles from Reaction day−{{n}} to Reaction day+{{n}} (split-adjusted prices); the vertical dash is the reaction day Reaction day, the horizontal dash the previous close C(Reaction day−1).
ui.events.method.base: The reference is the close of the session before Reaction day, C(Reaction day−1); C is a close, O an open.
ui.events.method.benchmark: The benchmark gets the same windows over the same dates; excess = stock − benchmark (a simple difference, not risk-adjusted); beat = excess above 0.
ui.events.method.cache: Each ticker (and the benchmark) is fetched once, covering [earliest Reaction day−n−1, latest Reaction day+n] of all events; after 24 hours the prices and these results are deleted and fetched again when opened. Export the CSV to keep a result.
ui.events.method.candle: One candle per event, in date order. Previous close is zero; open shows the gap and close shows the reaction. Up + and down − in the up/down colors, both filled. Click a candle to highlight the event everywhere.
ui.events.method.context: Background (context) and expectations come from the pasted AI answer and are not verified. Each event's K-line covers its background dates, so prices are fetched from the earliest background date as well.
ui.events.method.macro: Excluding major macro events leaves out an event when a background item marked major, of category macro data, policy or geopolitics, is dated within 2 trading sessions (configurable) before or after the reaction day; every statistic is then recomputed from the remaining events and the number left out is shown.
ui.events.method.missing: Sessions still to come are left empty with their expected date; a window without prices is left out of the statistics (never counted as 0).
ui.events.method.overlap: The three windows do not overlap: before ends at C(Reaction day−1), the reaction day runs from C(Reaction day−1) to C(Reaction day), after starts at C(Reaction day); each can be counted on its own and together they chain into the whole span. The gap is the opening part of the reaction day, shown separately, not counted twice.
ui.events.method.path: Average path: for each event C(t) / C(Reaction day−1) − 1 on every session from Reaction day−n to Reaction day+n; the median and quartiles are taken day by day; events without a price that day are left out of it.
ui.events.method.prices: Daily prices from Yahoo, adjusted for splits only; open, high, low and close carry the same split factor; cash dividends are not included.
ui.events.method.quartiles: Median, mean and quartiles (linear interpolation) use the same N events; the median absolute move ignores the direction.
ui.events.method.r: Reaction day Reaction day: before the open or during the session it is that day (the next session when the market is closed); after the close it is the next session; an unknown session is taken as that day and flagged.
ui.events.method.surprise: Surprise = (actual − estimate) / |estimate| for EPS and revenue. Earnings group by the EPS surprise: in line when its absolute value is below the configured threshold (1% by default), beat above, missed below; events without both EPS figures form their own group. Guidance groups use the AI's raised / maintained / lowered / none.
ui.events.method.up: Up = a change above 0; the 95% interval is the Wilson interval of the up share, assuming independent events; it describes the past, not a forecast; when it contains 50% it cannot be told apart from a coin flip.
ui.events.method.windows: Before {{n}} sessions = C(Reaction day−1) / C(Reaction day−1−n) − 1; reaction day = C(Reaction day) / C(Reaction day−1) − 1; opening gap = O(Reaction day) / C(Reaction day−1) − 1; after {{n}} sessions = C(Reaction day+n) / C(Reaction day) − 1.
